# CORE-DEM-02

**Is each goal traceable to an outcome, a use case or a capability, or explicitly recorded as an assumption?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | DEM: Demand and drivers |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `context.outcomes`, `context.serves`, `context.realises`, `drivers.assumptions` |

## Why it matters

Demand justifies a capability; a design whose demand is unstated cannot be prioritised or retired.

## Rule

At least one of context.outcomes, context.serves or context.realises is non-empty, or drivers.assumptions names the demand.
